Extract metadata returns document metadata when enabled

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"extract_metadata\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><title>Test Page</title><meta name='description' content='A test page'></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", options)
    println(result.content)
    println(result.metadata.document.title)
    println(result.metadata.document.description)
}
```
